title: Credential Guardian: interactive walkthrough + GIF template pack for API/SDK onboarding
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a compact, developer-focused asset pack that demonstrates credential lifecycle and streaming/toolcall flows via short looping GIFs, Lottie fallback, and static PNG sprite sheets. The goal is to replace large static screenshots in the API/SDK quickstart with lightweight microanimations that clarify: key creation, rotating device-code flow, streaming responses + progress indicator, and a tool-calling handshake (webhook + tool manifest). Assets must be optimized for docs (max 400KB GIF) and Console UI (SVG/Lottie vector alternatives). Include accessible color variants and 3 responsive sizes for docs, modal, and mobile snippet embeds.
deliverables: 6 looping GIF templates (auth-create, auth-rotate, device-code, stream-waves, toolcall-handshake, kv-cache-hint)
Lottie JSON fallbacks for streaming and handshake sequences
Figma master components and tokenized color styles
Microcopy pack: 8 short lines for captions and alt text
Export checklist and engineering handoff notes
dev_notes: GIFs must be sub-400KB for docs CDN. Use 6-8 frame loops for clarity.
Provide Lottie JSON and React component wrapper for Console (see design_tokens.md).
Include CSS animation fallback for environments that block JS-enabled embeds.
Provide alt text and 2 size variants: docs-inline (480x240) and modal (960x480).
Coordinate with infra: ensure assets served from docs-cdn and invalidation TTL documented.
